stem: What value of \(x\) satisfies the equation \(0.3x - 4 = 0.1x + 7\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the value of \(0.2x\), not \(x\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of adding \(0.1x\) and subtracting 4: \(0.4x = 3\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of subtracting 4 from 7 instead of adding it: \(0.2x = 3\).

verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve(Eq(Rational(3, 10)*x - 4, Rational(1, 10)*x + 7), x)[0]
assert s == 55
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
